items.title: I’m in my 40s. Should I accept a lower pension in exchange for naming my husband or child as a beneficiary?
items.description: “If I die before my husband, he will receive a lifetime pension equal to 50%–66% of my monthly benefit.”

items.title: United Airlines resolves system outage that delayed flights Monday
items.description: The outage came just days after an FAA ground stop disrupted air travel nationally.

items.title: Stanley Druckenmiller dumped these chip stocks while buying into SpaceX and Palantir
items.description: Druckenmiller’s family office unloaded AMD and Sandisk shares in the third quarter.

items.title: Do Amazon’s Black Friday deals really save you money? A new report casts doubt.
items.description: Almost a third of Amazon Black Friday deals “provided no savings at all” in the last two years, a report says. The retailer is pushing back.

items.title: My husband is happily retired at 64 and thinks I should keep working. Is he being fair?
items.description: “I’m exhausted. My alarm goes off at 6 a.m., and I have a 50-minute commute.”

items.title: U.S. dollar’s AI-driven breakout could become a stock-market wrecking ball
items.description: The dollar recently climbed to its strongest level in a year and a half.

items.title: Berkshire upped its bet on a beleaguered U.S. housing market, while souring on these bank stocks
items.description: Berkshire Hathaway stepped up its investments in the U.S. housing market last quarter, nearly doubling its stake in home builder Lennar.

items.title: ‘He calls my plans a fantasy’: My husband says we can’t afford a $200,000-a-year retirement. Is he being cheap?
items.description: “We have $2 million saved in our retirement accounts and a house worth $1.3 million.”

items.title: The FDA declined to approve one of biotech’s most closely watched cancer drugs. The company’s stock tumbled.
items.description: The regulator told Summit Therapeutics that the lung-cancer drug needs to prove it can help people live longer.

items.title: ‘It leaves me with a sour taste’: My elderly mother gave our cousin $800 for a car repair. Should I be worried?
items.description: “I know older people can easily feel patronized, and I don’t want that to happen.”
